likelihood_acquisition_cost.scope: separate acquisition only; no historical timing imported

measured_service_scope: Cached public features and released feedback through all guard decisions, synchronous journal/checkpoint and restart. No LLM or external feedback-provider request is measured.

boundaries.scope: synthetic basis and calibrated sparse-update controls; independent_n=0

timing_component_principles.design_and_initialization_ns: Complete design and state construction; includes design FFI, which has no separate shipped inner timer.
timing_component_principles.feature_gather_ns: Actual extraction from public source/answer bytes on every measured transaction.
timing_component_principles.ffi_ns: Outer gradient and guard call time minus Rust-reported arithmetic; includes Python conversion, state construction and call bookkeeping.
timing_component_principles.gradient_arithmetic_ns: The shipped per-step sparse coefficient timer.
timing_component_principles.gradient_construction_ns: Batch arithmetic time minus coefficient update time; includes calibrated probability and gradient construction.
timing_component_principles.guard_scans_ns: All guard policy and probability work excluding measured guard binding overhead.
timing_component_principles.orchestration_ns: Unassigned exclusive elapsed time within the transaction.
timing_component_principles.reload_ns: Reopen checkpoint and journal and reconstruct path state.
timing_component_principles.storage_fsync_ns: Synchronous SQLite journal and checkpoint write, file fsync and directory fsync.

trained_head_specs.operation: replay of frozen calibrated head; no benefit credit
